# D_Chart {#sec-doc}


::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}


```julia
D_Chart()
```
Chart choice for the D-chart based on generalized ordinal patterns (GOPs). The statistic is the squared Euclidean distance between the estimated GOP distribution and the in-control GOP distribution; see Weiß and Schnurr (2024).
 


:::
